message.content: In one of the discussions, ChaeSong-hwa expresses enthusiasm for organizing a karaoke night. Specifically, he suggests setting it up for the following Friday evening, stating, "Let's aim for this Friday evening then? Should be a good way to end the week! What do you guys think? 🎤✨". He also mentions that he will bring snacks to share, indicating his proactive planning for the event. ChaeSong-hwa looks forward to making the karaoke night a memorable and enjoyable experience, saying, "This is going to be a blast! I’ll bring some snacks too. See you all Friday! 🎤🍕✨".
